rules.title: H.5222 – An Act relative to preventing algorithmic rent fixing in the rental housing market
rules.requirement: Pending bill on algorithmic rent fixing in rental housing. It was reported favorably by the Housing Committee on 3/12/2026 and sent to House Ways and Means. The page does not give the bill's operative text, so its specific prohibitions are unknown. It is not law.
citation_aliases: H.1564 (earlier bill; H.5222 is a new draft)
rules.quoted_span: An Act relative to preventing algorithmic rent fixing in the rental housing market

parsed.doc_summary: The official page for Massachusetts bill H.5222 on algorithmic rent fixing. The bill was reported favorably by the Housing Committee on 3/12/2026 as a new draft of H.1564 and referred to House Ways and Means. It is still pending and the page gives no operative text.
